query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'caseId',case_id,'responseRequestId',response_request_id,'partyName',party_name,'submittedAt',submitted_at,'verifiedAt',verified_at,'publicExcerpt',public_excerpt,'publicationConsent',publication_consent,'editorialStatus',editorial_status,'version',version) ORDER BY submitted_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) FROM editorial.responses WHERE case_id=$1
